parsed.use_case: A document scanning service can search a page’s letter grid for many short labels or codes at once, where each match must follow neighboring cells and cannot reuse a cell. Similar matching can support word-finding puzzles or OCR post-processing over compact visual regions.
system_examples: OCR post-processing system — checks candidate words against neighboring recognized characters in a small image region.
Word puzzle game backend — validates many submitted or hidden words against a board of adjacent letters.
parsed.explanation: The key technique is to organize candidate words in a trie and backtrack through the grid, pruning a path as soon as its letter sequence cannot match any candidate. This avoids restarting a full search for every word and can be much faster than checking each word independently, though worst-case work remains exponential in path length. The pattern has limited direct use in general production search; it is most relevant to word games and specialized OCR or visual-text matching.
